people.name: John
people.line: The Baptist, a prophet who prepared the way for Jesus

translations.web: The law and the prophets were until John. From that time the Good News of God’s Kingdom is preached, and everyone is forcing his way into it.
translations.bsb: The Law and the Prophets were proclaimed until John. Since that time, the gospel of the kingdom of God is being preached, and everyone is forcing his way into it.
translations.kjv: The law and the prophets were until John: since that time the kingdom of God is preached, and every man presseth into it.
translations.asv: The law and the prophets were until John: from that time the gospel of the kingdom of God is preached, and every man entereth violently into it.
